subject: Renewal negotiation: MSA term changes + expanded order form (50% capacity add)
messages:
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@gravitonhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Graviton Health Procurement <procurement@gravitonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + proposed MSA changes and capacity order form

Hi Priyom —

Hope you’re well. We’re approaching our contract renewal window with Redwood (contract id 4721) and would like to propose the following for the upcoming 12‑month term:

- Move from 36 month auto‑renew to a 12 month renewable term (customer preference).
- Add an expanded Order Form for an immediate +50% capacity bump (see attached CSV for line items).
- Minor changes to data retention and audit notice windows (please see the redline PDF attached).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a 12 month term and accommodate the order form by July 1? If full acceptance isn’t possible, we’ll need to understand which clauses you’d like to keep by exception so we can loop in our legal.

Attached: Graviton_MSA_renewal_request_20260615.pdf (summary + proposed term sheet)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

—
Sasha Nguyen
Director, Vendor Management
Graviton Health
sasha.nguyen@gravitonhealth.com
+1 415‑555‑0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + proposed MSA changes and capacity order form

Sasha —

Thanks for sending the request and the summary. We can definitely prioritize the capacity increase. A few quick notes up front:

- Capacity: engineering confirmed the +50% pool bump is feasible; we can target July 1 activation if we sign the Order Form and finalize a payment schedule by 06/25.
- Term: our standard renewal cadence is 24 months for committed discounts; 12 months is doable but will affect pricing. I’ll flag for commercial approval.
- Legal redlines: forwarding your PDF to Laura (legal) and Marissa (AM) to propose specific counter language and exceptions.

I’ll coordinate with Legal and return a single redline packet (MSA + OrderForm) by EOD Wednesday. If you can share any Must‑Haves from counsel, that’ll speed review.

Proposed next step: quick call Thursday 6/17 11:00am PDT to walk redlines and any pricing delta. Would that work?

Cheers,

—
Priyom Das
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal window + proposed MSA changes and capacity order form

Team —

I reviewed Sasha’s packet. High‑level legal position:

1) Term: We can accept a 12 month term only if we revert the committed pricing back to list (no multi‑year discount) or add a minimum monthly commitment. I recommend a compromise clause: 12 month initial term with an option to extend at prior pricing if exercised 30 days before term end.

2) Data retention/audit windows: we can agree to shorten audit notice to 15 days for non‑sensitive audits but must preserve 30 days for regulated audits. I’ve inserted precise carve‑outs in the attached redline (GRV_MSA_Redlines_v1.docx).

3) Order Form: commercially fine. Need clearer payment milestones in the CSV (upfront deposit + 3 equal invoices). See OrderForm_Expanded_50pct.csv (I added a payments column).

Attached: GRV_MSA_Redlines_v1.docx (MS Word redline), OrderForm_Expanded_50pct.csv (line items + payment suggestion)

If Priyom and Marissa sign off, I’ll send the redline back to Sasha and ask for a negotiated call Thursday 6/17 11:00am PDT.

—
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura@redwoodinference.com

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@gravitonhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Graviton Health Procurement <procurement@gravitonhealth.com>, Jennifer Lin <jennifer.lin@gravitonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal window + proposed MSA changes and capacity order form

Thanks, Priyom and Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is Graviton’s own redline to the MSA (highlights: request to keep 12 month term firm; language tightening on data ownership; ask for 45 day termination notice for non‑payment).

We’re open to a pricing delta with the 12 month term; we submitted an internal ask for a 10% uplift on list to cover the shorter term. On payment terms: Graviton can do a 25% deposit + net30 for each milestone — not upfront 50%.

Attached: Graviton_MSA_RedlineFromClient.docx; note the section with 45‑day termination is negotiable if Redwood can increase audit notice to 21 days instead of 15.

We’re still good for the call Thursday 6/17 11:00am; Jennifer from procurement will join.

—
Sasha Nguyen
Director, Vendor Management
Graviton Health

Subject: Re: Renewal window + proposed MSA changes and capacity order form — next steps

Sasha / Jennifer —

Thanks for the redlines and for confirming the call earlier today. Quick summary and next steps from Redwood: 

- Pricing: Commercial will prepare two options by EOD Monday 6/21 — (A) 12 month term with +10% list uplift; (B) 24 month term with 0% uplift and a minimum monthly commitment. We’ll include a cost/latency tradeoff model per option.
- Legal: Laura proposes counter language for the 45‑day termination / audit notice: agree 21 days for non‑sensitive audits, 30 days for regulated. See attached GRV_MSA_Redlines_v2.docx (redline with client edits integrated).
- Payments: Redwood accepts a 25% deposit option; we’ll mirror client milestone phrasing but propose net45 for milestone invoices. Finance will produce a final payment schedule after pricing option selected.
- Order Form: I attached the updated CSV with SKU mappings and delivery timeline for activation July 1 contingent on signed order and deposit (OrderForm_Expanded_50pct.csv).

Next calls: 
- Finance & Procurement: Monday 6/21 10:00am PDT to pick pricing option (30m).
- Final legal signoff: Thursday 6/24 9:00am PDT if required.

I’ll upload the integrated redline + order form to the shared drive and route the DocuSign envelope once pricing is selected. Links below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cGRV-renewal-terms
DocuSign (sample envelope): https://app.docusign.com/RECIPIENT/signing/abcdef-2026-06-18

If that timeline works for Graviton, we’ll aim to have capacity live July 1.

Thanks —
